formAfterApply.title: FFmpeg: Comprehensive Multimedia Processing Libraries and Tools
formAfterApply.description: FFmpeg is a collection of powerful libraries and command-line tools for processing multimedia content including audio, video, subtitles, and metadata. It provides codec implementations (libavcodec), streaming protocol support (libavformat), filtering capabilities (libavfilter), and utilities for color conversion, resampling, and device access—widely used for encoding, transcoding, and streaming applications.
